# netbox_journal_entry (Data Source)

Retrieves a single journal entry from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_journal_entry" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "journal_entry_id" {
  value = data.netbox_journal_entry.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the journal entry.
- `created_by` (Number) The created by of the journal entry.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the journal entry.
- `kind` (String) The kind of the journal entry.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_object` (String) The assigned object of the journal entry.
- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The assigned object id of the journal entry.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the journal entry.
- `created` (String) When the journal entry was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the journal entry, as a map of field name to value.
- `last_updated` (String) When the journal entry was last changed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
